title: 线法桥 Xianfa Qiao
subtitle: bridge south of 蓄水楼 · Xiyang Lou

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

questions.title: Halls in the texts and not on the plan

evidence.title: 线法桥
evidence.locator: zh.wikipedia 圆明园, 西洋楼 section
evidence.summary: South of 蓄水楼 against the west wall of 长春园: five arches with beast faces spouting water, and a false door with a large Western clock in the centre, carved walls either side. Parts were later moved to Yenching University. A lead: not seen on a Qing source. No engraving of the 20 is named for it.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣样式雷图 (样986), 朱墨 底样, 设计与踏勘草图
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样986号
evidence.summary: Update to E0935: red lines mark three supply pipes from 蓄水楼 to 谐奇趣's pools; on the right, field notes of a two-storey elevation, a fountain, and a five-arch sluice elevation. Useful for the pipe run and the 线法桥 sluice.

photos.title: 谐奇趣南面 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 一 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: Printed title; the two octagonal music pavilions and the south pool stand on the plate. Viewer looks north: XY01-01 (west) is on the left, XY01-N01 (east) on the right. Roof behind the west colonnade; arcaded water structure with gate tower at the left edge.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.visible: left edge: arcaded water structure with balustrade and a tall ornate gate tower, cropped by the plate edge

facts.label: Position
facts.value: Not placed: the name was not found on the plan.

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 5 arches, at the west wall; 水闸 links to YM (S06). Stone moved to 燕京大学 (S06). A bridge named by S06 only; nothing drawn close south of 蓄水楼 on S01. S01 writes 五孔闸 at (8688,1740), three diamond piers on the wall line west of 谐奇趣's lake: same wall, sluice, and 5 openings like S06's 5 arches. (S06;S01, Round 6).
